sections.text_helper: Section 28.4.21 "XSPI reconfiguration or deactivation" in chapter 28 (Extended-SPI interface (XSPI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1323.
sections.section_content:
Before any XSPI reconfiguration, the software must ensure that all the transactions are
completed:
• After a memory-mapped write, the software must perform a dummy read followed by a
synchronization barrier, then an abort.
• After a memory-mapped read, the software must perform a synchronization barrier
then an abort.
